manifest_shape.loader_contract: roles[] holds only kit-local display plates: id/role/path/size/sha256/textless=true/source=curated_kit, every path relative and inside the kit directory, PNG. `resolution[role].source` names the 2x sibling a full-bleed plate is encoded from. Shared-kernel rows are references, not roles: they live in kernel.assets with their repo-relative path and sha256 and must be resolved through kernel.assets, never mounted as a kit-local plate.
manifest_shape.generation_log: the generation.json sidecar beside this manifest, pinned by sha256 here rather than inlined
divergences: a `section` role is VQ-008's own; field_atlas@2 has none, and the section ships no 2x sibling
covers are two aspects of one generic display cover, not per-course covers
generation_log is a pinned sidecar, not an inlined list
field_atlas@2 copies its kernel bytes into the kit and lists them as roles; these kits keep one shared kernel and declare it as references in kernel.assets, so roles stay kit-local plates

ocr_policy.tool: tesseract default page segmentation on the shipped plate
ocr_policy.fail_rule: a token of >= 3 alphanumeric characters at confidence >= 60
ocr_policy.calibration: real UI strings on refs/home.png and refs/classroom.png score 74-95; painted line art on these plates scores 12-52
ocr_policy.limitation: OCR is a cheap backstop, not the textless control. Recall measured this round on the shipped lab_bench hero with Liberation Sans Bold burned in: 120 pt 'TORQUE 45 Nm' and 'CAUTION' return no readable token at default page segmentation or at psm 6/11/12; 72 pt returns only isolated one-character fragments ('7' at 82.3, '4' at 59.4); 48 pt and 32 pt return nothing. A legible 120 pt line scoring zero shows recall does not rise with type size, and an independent 72 pt probe recovered one three-character fragment at 90.9, so a clean OCR run is not evidence that a plate is textless. The primary control is the recorded per-plate vision pass: every accepted row in generation.json must carry a vision and a residual verdict, and --check refuses an accepted row without either and a kit whose hero, 3:2 cover, section or lesson scene has no accepted row behind it. Painted pseudo-lettering is the same case with less contrast.

provenance.prompt:
A full-bleed painted scene of a room or workspace, not a still life, and not a screenshot. The painting is cropped hard edge to edge by the frame: no torn or deckled paper edge, no white margin, no vignette, no border, no picture frame. Three depth planes: painted foreground props, a midground bench or table, and an architectural background with a window, door or opening, paler in the distance. Do not paint the words of this instruction anywhere: there is no title, no caption, no heading and no label in the image.

Subject: a wide drafting board seen at a slight angle, an open quiet surface across the upper two thirds. BACKGROUND: the warm wall behind the board, a low shelf with rolled paper tubes and a tall window at the right onto soft daylight. MIDGROUND: the board with a plain unmarked surface that fades into warm wall toward the top, brass dividers, a plain wooden set square with no markings, a ruled straightedge with no figures and a chalk tray holding plain white chalk sticks. FOREGROUND: the board edge running off the bottom edge, a wooden stool and a rolled sheet of paper.

Composition: a quiet drafting board seen at a slight angle; the blueprint grid fades out under the headline field.

Grammar motifs: graph paper, blackboard, brass dividers, ruler, chalk tray.

The upper third of the frame is a quiet field reserved for a headline typeset later: a plain painted surface with a couple of faint broad brush marks, low contrast, no small detail, reaching the top edge of the frame, still painted environment and not bare parchment.

Painted in opaque gouache on warm paper, dark warm-brown ink contour drawn last, thick body colour, visible flat brush-shaped marks in every mass, crisp brush-stopped edges, one soft key light from the upper left, one shade plane down-right in a darker tint of the same pigment. Never pure black, no gradient, no glow, no bloom, no vignette.

Warm pigments only, at most 5: warm paper, dark brown ink, field green, ochre, coral. No blue, no grey, no neutral black, no steel, no chrome, no concrete.

Orientation art only. No numbers, no figures, no equations, no axis labels, no grid numbering, no scale, no protractor markings, no measurement. The board is a quiet surface and never a worked example, a proof or a required lesson visual.

Textless: no letters, words, numbers, labels, signage, notice board, wall chart, poster, chalkboard, framed picture, watermark, logo or UI chrome. Every page, chart, card, book, ledger and sheet is plain blank cream paper: no ruled lines, no grid, no drawn diagram, no scribble, no writing, no printed mark. Every tool, instrument, tin, jar and badge is plain and unengraved: no stamped letters, no maker's mark, no etched numbering, no dial face. No people, hands, faces, animals or fox.

provenance.pipeline: magick -modulate 105,75,100, applied to the provider raw before any crop or resize; then crop/resize; then magick -clamp +level 4%,100% applied last, after the resize (ART-BIBLE §9 rule 5)

quiet_field.note: the flattest band this plate actually offers in the upper 45%, chosen by the better of its measured contrast against contract ink and against cream paper
